title: Klick
summary: KLICK, verb intransitive [a different orthography or diminutive of clack.] 1. To make a small, sharp sound by striking two things together. 2. In Scotland, to pilfer, by taking with a snatch. KLICK, n

inlines.v: KLICK, verb intransitive [a different orthography or diminutive of clack.] 1. To make a small, sharp sound by striking two things together. 2. In Scotland, to pilfer, by taking with a snatch. KLICK, noun A stroke or blow. [A word in vulgar use.]
